data.min_face_quality: Minimum face quality for unmatched faces (0-100)
data.enrollment_enabled: Automatic customer enrollment (adds new faces to the camera's Customers library)

clock_skew.title: Camera clock is off
clock_skew.description: The camera clock differs from Home Assistant by {seconds} seconds. Statistics use Home Assistant time, but the camera time should be corrected (NTP).

app_state_drift.title: Camera analytics apps not running
app_state_drift.description: These required camera apps are not running: {apps}. Face events may be missing. Techmark Analysis never starts or stops camera apps; check the camera.

enrollment_candidates_lost.title: Customer enrollment candidates were lost
enrollment_candidates_lost.description: {total} unknown-face candidate(s) could not be enrolled so far ({reasons}). restart: pending when Home Assistant restarted (face crops are kept in memory only); overflow: queue memory budget exceeded; no_image: the camera image never arrived; upload_failed: camera unreachable after all retries. These people can still be enrolled on a later visit.

generate_report.name: Generate report
generate_report.description: Generate a daily or monthly report (Markdown and CSV in /config/techmark_reports).

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to report, or any day in the month. Defaults to today.

list_faces.name: List faces
list_faces.description: List names in a camera face library (read-only).

export_attendance.name: Export attendance CSV
export_attendance.description: Admin only. Employee first-in / last-seen per day as CSV (Home Assistant time zone). Last seen is the last camera match, not a confirmed departure.

range.name: Range
range.description: today, yesterday, this_week (Monday start), this_month, or custom

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day (custom range), at most 366 days

export_visitors.name: Export customer visitor report
export_visitors.description: Admin only. Permanent customer visit history as CSV: one visitor's visits, a per-visitor annual report, or monthly statistics. Unique visitors, visit days (one per visitor per day) and raw recognition events are reported separately.

year.name: Year
year.description: Annual/monthly reports; defaults to the current year

erase_visitor.name: Erase visitor
erase_visitor.description: Admin only. Deletes one visitor's visit history, match records and exported visitor CSVs. The visitor number stays retired. Delete the face from the camera library separately.
